items.title: Solar panel makers trim orders as inventories build up
items.summary: Several solar manufacturers said they would slow purchases of raw materials after inventories rose, a possible drag on industrial demand for silver.

items.title: Factory activity index slips for a second month
items.summary: A manufacturing survey pointed to weaker factory activity, adding to concerns about industrial metals demand.

items.title: Precious metals funds see small inflows
items.summary: Weekly flow data from an industry tracker showed modest inflows into precious metals funds, partly offsetting weaker industrial sentiment.
